SPACE_BEFORE CONVENTION: gap between the element's top and the bottom of the nearest element directly above it in the same flow. Explicit references used: running_header from the header band; n=1 from the running header; n=2 from n=1; n=3 from n=2; major_heading from the panel's INNER top rule (y=1142); inner paragraph from the heading baseline; leaf motif from the panel's top edge (y=1132); page_number from the corner motif (y=212), the previous element in the outer margin, hence the large 0.636; footer_rule from the folio block; foot line from the footer rule; the band, the corner motif and the watermark have nothing above them (0.000).  SIZE_PT IS DERIVED, SIZE_REL IS MEASURED: size_pt = measured cap-height px x 0.36 pt/px divided by an assumed cap-height/em of 0.70 (serif) or 0.72 (sans). dpi is exact here but the cap/em ratio is an assumption, so trust size_rel. Measured cap heights: body 21.1, summary body 19.1, SUMMARY heading 25, running head 16, foot line 16, folio digits 28 px.  NOT MEASURABLE: the panel's double-rule colour is given only in this note (#e5dd4c) because a 2 px scanned rule is partly antialiased and no flat interior exists; the running head's ink reads #6a6a6a at its darkest core, which may be a grey the scanner lightened rather than a designed grey.
